preconditions.description: The length of the permutation n must be between 1 and 50.
The index k must be between 1 and the minimum of 10^18 and the length of Kyoya's list l.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: All integers in the output must be within the range from 1 to n.
The output must match the k-th permutation in Kyoya's list.
